preamble: In many Southern varieties the Middle Chinese palatal nasal initial (rì 日) became an alveolar fricative [z].

examples.from: 人 MC nyin [ɲ] (in 人民 rénmín)
examples.note: Literary reading; the colloquial reading of 日 is gniq, with ɲ kept.

sources: Norman, J. (1988). Chinese. Cambridge University Press.
